Post 1
📉 Eight points. That's all the ASX 200 lost Wednesday, closing at 8,727.70 — but beneath the calm, Arena REIT surged 12.98% while scrap metal and gold names bled. Flat index, violent internals. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
🏠 A-REITs +0.80% and Health Care +1.09% led Wednesday. Financials dragged at -0.59%. Defensive rotation doing the heavy lifting while cyclicals stall. #ASX #ausbiz #realestate

Post 3
🔺 ARF closed at AUD 2.35, up 27 cents or 12.98% — the standout move of the session. No single stock told today's story more clearly: yield-sensitive property trusts are back in favour. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 4
🪙 Gold at AUD 5,963.00/oz with AUD/USD at 0.6974. Silver at AUD 87.23/oz. Metals priced richly in local terms — a weaker Aussie dollar doing the work even as gold names sold off. #gold #silver #ASX

Post 5
Watch gold miners. AUD gold at AUD 5,963/oz yet EMR fell 4.37% Wednesday. If spot holds and the sector can't rally, that's a signal. Are miners pricing in something the metal isn't? #ASX #gold #ausbiz
